query:
SELECT 
  'Users' as entity, COUNT(*) as count, 'All users have IDs' as status 
FROM users 
WHERE id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Staff with IDs' as entity, COUNT(*) as count, 'All staff have staff numbers' as status 
FROM users 
WHERE staffNumber IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Attendance Records' as entity, COUNT(*) as count, 'Valid check-in times' as status 
FROM attendance 
WHERE checkInTime IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Checked Out Staff' as entity, COUNT(*) as count, 'Staff with check-out times' as status 
FROM attendance 
WHERE checkOutTime IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Timesheets Submitted' as entity, COUNT(*) as count, 'Submitted timesheets' as status 
FROM attendance 
WHERE submittedAt IS NOT NULL
